CustomField.description: Email aliaes that should be notified on L2 escalations (comma separated)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The L2 Email Alias is used for Case Escalations. For example, when a L2 Escalation for this team is raised this email alias (or aliases) will receive an email to this group. To specify a single email alias, simply type in the email alias, foo@tanium.com or specify multiple email aliases via comma separated values foo@tanium.com,bar@tanium.com.
CustomField.label: L2 Email Aliases
